info.title: API.SH: Ontario Cannabis Store
info.description: The Ontario Cannabis Store API from API.SH: public Ontario Cannabis Store data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
What the ocs.ca search box suggests for some typed text: suggested searches, products (price, price range, availability, image, attributes), collections, pages and articles.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocs-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Typed text.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Suggestions per kind (1-10, default 6).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: en (default) or fr.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every brand in the Ontario Cannabis Store catalogue with its product count, optionally within a category or subcategory, or matching a name.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocs-brands

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma list of categories, e.g. Flower, Vapes.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Comma list of subcategories.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only brands whose name contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The Ontario Cannabis Store's collections (categories, brands, curated and seasonal lists): id, handle, title, link, product count, description, image and dates. Use a handle as `collection` in the search endpoint. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocs-collections

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 = first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Collections per page (1-100, default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Ontario Cannabis Store product by handle, numeric id or ocs.ca link: title (and French title), description, brand, licensed producer, category path, plant type, strain name, THC and CBD ranges, potency labels, cannabinoid ratio, terpenes, allergens, craft and Ontario-grown flags, growing province, method, medium, drying and trimming methods, every tag as `attributes`, images, collections, and every size with price, compare-at price, SKU, barcode, weight, stock and stock quantity, online or in-store availability, price per unit and THC/CBD per size, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocs-product

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Product handle (the part after /products/ in the link).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric product id, instead of handle.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An ocs.ca product link, instead of handle.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: en (default) or fr.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Ontario Cannabis Store catalogue (ocs.ca, the province's legal online and wholesale cannabis store) with every filter the shop has: category, subcategory, sub-subcategory, brand, plant type, terpene, allergen, size, online or in-store availability, collection, craft, Ontario grown, in stock, on sale, price range and THC/CBD range, in 8 sorts, in English or French. Each product: id, handle, link, title (and French title), brand, licensed producer, category path, plant type, size, SKU, barcode, price and compare-at price (CAD), price per unit, price range across sizes, stock and stock quantity, THC and CBD ranges, potency labels, cannabinoid ratio, terpenes, allergens, craft and Ontario-grown flags, growing province and method, strain name, image, collections and `raw`. Also returns facet counts for every filter and price statistics. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocs-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (product, brand or strain name). Leave out to browse.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma list of categories, e.g. Flower, Extracts, Vapes, Edibles, Topicals, Accessories (values from `facets.category`).

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Comma list, e.g. Pre-Rolls, Dried Flower, 510 Thread Cartridges, Soft Chews, Beverages (values from `facets.subcategory`).

parameters.name: subsubcategory
parameters.description: Comma list, e.g. Single-Strain Pre-Rolls, Whole Flower, Diamonds (values from `facets.subsubcategory`).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Comma list of brand names (values from `facets.brand` or the brands endpoint).

parameters.name: plant_type
parameters.description: Comma list: Indica Dominant, Sativa Dominant, Hybrid, Blend.

parameters.name: terpene
parameters.description: Comma list, e.g. Limonene, Myrcene, Caryophyllene.

parameters.name: allergen
parameters.description: Comma list of declared allergens, e.g. SOY, MILK.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Comma list of sizes, e.g. 3.5g, 7g, 3x0.5g (values from `facets.size`).

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: online (sold on ocs.ca) or in-store (sold to licensed stores only).

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A collection handle from the collections endpoint, e.g. flower or pre-rolls.

parameters.name: craft
parameters.description: true: craft products only; false: exclude them.

parameters.name: ontario_grown
parameters.description: true: Ontario-grown products only.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true: only sizes with stock.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: true: only products with a compare-at (reduced) price.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in CAD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price in CAD.

parameters.name: thc_min
parameters.description: Minimum THC in the site's units (mg/g for dried products, so 200 = 20%; mg per unit for edibles and oils).

parameters.name: thc_max
parameters.description: Maximum THC in the same units.

parameters.name: cbd_min
parameters.description: Minimum CBD in the same units.

parameters.name: cbd_max
parameters.description: Maximum CBD in the same units.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default relevance). Sorts other than relevance are English only.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: en (default) or fr: French titles and links.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 = first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (1-48, default 24).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocs-store

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Store id or page slug (from the stores endpoint).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Authorized (AGCO-licensed) cannabis retail stores in Ontario from the Ontario Cannabis Store's store locator: near coordinates within a radius, around a postal code, in a city, or by name. Each store: id, name, open flag, address, city, postal code, coordinates, distance, phone, email, website, logo, description (English and French), opening hours per day and page slug. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ocs-stores

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name, e.g. Toronto or Ottawa.

parameters.name: postal_code
parameters.description: A postal code or its first three characters, e.g. M5V; results are sorted by distance.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude (with lng).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude (with lat).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Radius in km around lat/lng or the postal code (default 25, max 500).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only stores whose name or address contains this text.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: true: only stores marked open.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 = first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores per page (1-100, default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
